mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author_id, u.username as author_name, c.content, c.created_at FROM task_comments c JOIN users u ON c.author_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_comments (post_id, author_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_comments SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
